prompt_text: I need a personal injury attorney in Chicago after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
Here are several Chicago personal-injury firms you should call after a car accident, with why each one is worth contacting. I’ve included suggested priorities so you can choose 3–4 to call first.

Top firms to call and why

1. Clifford Law Offices
- Why: Long-established Chicago plaintiff firm with heavy experience in catastrophic car-accident cases, high-value settlements and trials, and resources to hire accident reconstruction experts and treaters.
- Best for: Serious injuries, wrongful death, complex liability questions, cases needing major resources.

2. Corboy & Demetrio
- Why: One of Illinois’s best-known personal-injury firms, strong trial record, large plaintiff practice that handles automobile collisions, traumatic brain injury, and catastrophic care.
- Best for: Clients who may need a firm with deep litigation and courtroom experience.

3. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.
- Why: Plaintiff-focused, frequently handles motor vehicle collisions and truck/vehicle negligence cases, known for aggressive representation and contingency-fee acceptance.
- Best for: Standard to serious car-accident claims; firms that are plaintiff-minded.

4. Power Rogers & Smith, LLP
- Why: Experienced with commercial vehicle and trucking collisions, including cross-border truck issues and complex liability for carriers.
- Best for: Truck accidents or collisions involving commercial vehicles.

5. Kralovec, Jambois & Schwartz (KJS Trial Lawyers)
- Why: Regional personal injury firm with trial experience and a track record in car accident cases, often responsive to clients and familiar with Chicago courts.
- Best for: Clients wanting a trial-ready plaintiff firm with strong local experience.

6. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard — already listed; alternatively, consider a boutique firm you find via local bar association if you want a smaller team with a personal touch.

How to decide which to call first
- If you or a loved one has catastrophic injuries, call Clifford Law Offices and Corboy & Demetrio first.
- If a truck or commercial vehicle was involved, call Power Rogers & Smith first.
- If injuries are moderate and you want a local firm that handles a high volume of auto claims, call Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard or KJS.

What to ask when you call (quick script)
- Do you handle car-accident personal-injury cases like mine?
- How many cases like this have you taken to trial/settlement and what outcomes have you had? (They may not give exact numbers, but listen for relevant experience.)
- Who in the firm will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your fee structure? (Most PI firms work on contingency—no recovery, no fee—ask for the percentage and any costs you might be responsible for.)
- Do you offer a free consultation and will you handle the insurance communications?
- Are you familiar with the local courts where my case would be filed?

What to have ready when you call or meet
- Date/time/location of the crash, police report number (if any), name(s) of other drivers and insurance company names, photos of the scene/vehicle/injuries, medical records or treatment summaries, and witness contact info.
- Note: Illinois’s statute of limitations for most personal-injury claims is generally two years from the date of injury, with some exceptions—call soon so evidence and claims aren’t jeopardized.

Next steps I can help with
- If you’d like, I can look up phone numbers, addresses, and current client reviews for any of these firms, or find firms that match a specific need (e.g., Spanish-speaking, low-volume boutique, or firms that handle motorcycle crashes). Tell me which you prefer and I’ll pull details.
